Two editions

For you, and for your company.

Personal

Everything you meant to remember.

Send a ticket, a bill or a voice note on WhatsApp. SecondBrain files it, links it to the right trip, person or deadline, and brings it back when it matters.

  • Documents you can find by asking
  • Preferences learned from ordinary conversation
  • Morning briefings from your calendar and mail
  • Reminders that know the context, not just the time

Enterprise

What your company knows, in one place.

Decisions, vendor terms, customer history and the way things are done usually live in a few people’s heads. SecondBrain makes that knowledge shared, permissioned and usable by agents.

  • Shared memory with roles and access controls
  • Sources attached to every answer
  • Agents that act on company memory, with approvals
  • A record of what was done and why

Principles

How SecondBrain treats what it knows.

Provenance

Every remembered fact carries its source: you said it, a document showed it, or a calendar confirmed it. Nothing guessed is presented as known.

Correction

You can see what is remembered and change it. When you remove a memory, it is removed, not hidden.

Scope

Personal memory stays personal. Company memory follows the company’s permissions. The two never mix by default.

Expiry

A flight ends, a gate code changes, an offer lapses. Facts are allowed to age out instead of being acted on after they stop being true.
